accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_policy: Mandatory data-testid attributes on all interactive CTAs, inputs, navigation links, and KPI metrics

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app works cleanly across three distinct routes: '/' (Public Landing Page), '/admin' (SaaS Dashboard & Client Management), and '/demo/cliente-exemplo' (Dark Theme Mobile Digital Card).
Use Lucide-React icons for clean vector representation of all social and contact buttons (WhatsApp, MapPin, Instagram, Facebook, Video, Star, Phone, etc.).
Maintain high whitespace and clean borders (1px border-slate-200 in light mode, 1px border-zinc-800 in dark mode). No harsh rainbow gradients or childish emojis.
All form fields in '/admin' multi-section client form must render accurately with standard shadcn or clean custom styled input components.

The mini site '/demo/cliente-exemplo' must feel like an authentic mobile card web app with dark elegant surface (#09090B), crisp profile badge, clean call-to-action buttons, working hours table, and service listing.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive button, menu link, form input, and table action item for robust test verification.
